ASBESTOS DISCOVERY 220, PETITIONER MARY FRANCIS NELSON'S PETITION TO PERPETUATE TESTIMONY OF CHESTER NELSON BY VIDEOTAPED ORAL DEPOSITION. ARGUED AND TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: GRANTED AS TO ALL PROSPECTIVE DEFENDANTS NAMED IN THE PETITION EXCEPT FREDERICK MEISWINKEL, INC. AND SWINERTON BUILDERS, AS TO WHOM THE PETITION IS DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO BEING REFILED WITH FURTHER INFORMATION. ONLY FREDERICK MEISWINKEL, INC. AND SWINERTON BUILDERS FILED ANY OPPOSITION PAPERS. THE PETITION FAILS TO EXPLAIN WHY MR. NELSON IS NOW EXPECTED TO OFFER TESTIMONY AGAINST FREDERICK MEISWINKEL, INC. AND SWINERTON BUILDERS WHEN HE DID NOT DO SO IN HIS PERSONAL INJURY ACTION. PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE THE ORDER. JUDGE: HAROLD KAHN, MATTER NOT REPORTED
